'''Olga Forgewarmth''' is a [[dwarf]] priestess located at [[Lion's Watch]] in [[Northwind]]. She is a traveling companion with the night elf twins [[Maener Owlgarden|Maener]] and [[Steria Owlgarden]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Ay, by the Light, these elves and their long legs! Bah, I need to be up on my feet—I'm here to see [[Crawford Winery|that winery]]! I must see for myself what had those elves in [[Alah'thalas]] so happy.
